name: Rin'ji's Secret
summary: After helping Rin'ji, you carry Rin'ji's Secret, a tablet marked in Witherbark script that no one has read. Oran Snakewrithe studies the Witherbark and may decipher it. He is known to live in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

sections.title: A Tablet Nobody Can Read
sections.body: Witherbark troll markings cover the tablet, but what Rin'ji's secret is remains a mystery. It may be worth a great deal or nothing at all. A Witherbark troll in trouble might try anything to escape it.

sections.title: A Scholar in the Undercity
sections.body: Oran Snakewrithe is a well-known scholar of the Witherbark trolls. He is known to live in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity and may be able to read the tablet.

faq.q: Where did this tablet come from?
aliases: how do i get the tablet
faq.answer: The tablet is the secret Rin'ji hid at the Overlook Cliffs. You found it after helping Rin'ji escape from Quel'Danil Lodge.

faq.q: Who can read the markings on the tablet?
faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe knows the Witherbark trolls well and may be able to decipher the markings.
Oran Snakewrithe is known to live in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Nobody can say. The tablet may be worth a great deal or nothing at all, since a Witherbark troll in distress might try anything to escape trouble.
